scenes.text: Five stops, one rail pass, and the best of Japan.
Start in Tokyo, under the Skytree, the tallest tower in the country.
Then west to Mount Fuji, Japan's highest peak.
Kyoto was the imperial capital for more than a thousand years.
Next door, Osaka, and its castle tower rebuilt in 1931.
And finally Miyajima, where the shrine gate seems to float at high tide.
